TEXT.START_TEXT: Thank you for taking part in this experiment. Please read the following instructions and ask the experimenter if you have any questions. On each page, you will see a reference audio player (labelled Ref) and a request that describes a desired modification to that audio. You will also see a number of audio players (A, B, and so on), each of which will play a different modification of the reference audio. Your task is to judge how well the modification has achieved the request. You can use the mouse or the keyboard number keys to switch between the audio excerpts. You can only move the slider for the audio expert that is currently playing, and if you want to give a rating of 0, you must move the slider up and then back down, becuase you need to move all the sliders before continuing to the next page.
TEXT.CONSENT_TEXT:
By continuing with this experiment, you are giving your consent to the following.

In this experiment, we will collect your responses and the time taken to complete each page.

We will not collect any personal data that can be used to identify you. All responses will be stored anonymously (please note that this means we will not be able to remove your responses after the experiment session has finished).

We may use your responses, either individually or aggregated across assessors, for: (i) evaluating and developing products or technologies; (ii) internal and external reports, publications, and/or marketing; and/or (iii) training and testing statistical models (including using machine learning approaches).

You are free to withdraw from the experiment at any time without needing to justify your decision and without prejudice.

If you have any questions before, during, or after the session, please contact the experimenter.
TEXT.RESUME_TEXT: Please ask the experimenter if you need a reminder of the experiment task or if you have any other questions. Press Start to resume the experiment session.
TEXT.METHOD_FAMILIARISATION_START_MESSAGE: The following pages are provided for you to become familiar with the experiment methodology and the user interface.
TEXT.METHOD_FAMILIARISATION_END_MESSAGE: Please ask the experimenter if you have any questions. Results for the following pages will be saved. Please press Continue when you're ready.
TEXT.ATTRIBUTE_FINISHED_MESSAGE: Please take a short break, and press Continue when you're ready to proceed with the next attribute.
TEXT.EXPERIMENT_FINISHED_MESSAGE: The experiment is complete and your results have been saved. Thanks very much for participating.
TEXT.SESSION_FINISHED_MESSAGE: This session is complete. Please confirm the date and time of your next session with the experimenter.
